entries.name: SAQ Teaching Veterinary Hospital (CVASU)
entries.address: Clinical Building, Chattogram Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, Khulshi, Chattogram 4225
entries.duty: Sun-Thu 9:00-17:00, Sat 9:00-14:00; closed on public holidays. Treats dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and turtles; emergency calls via the ambulatory service.
entries.note: University page; says no 24 h service yet (planned). Lunch break 13:00-14:00.

duty_i18n.pl: Niedz.–czw. 9:00–17:00, sob. 9:00–14:00; w święta państwowe zamknięte. Leczy psy, koty, ptaki, króliki i żółwie; w nagłych przypadkach wezwanie przez służbę mobilną.
duty_i18n.cs: Ne–Čt 9:00–17:00, so 9:00–14:00; o státních svátcích zavřeno. Ošetřují psy, kočky, ptáky, králíky a želvy; pohotovostní výjezdy přes výjezdní službu.
duty_i18n.sv: Sön–tors 9.00–17.00, lör 9.00–14.00; stängt på helgdagar. Behandlar hundar, katter, fåglar, kaniner och sköldpaddor; akuta samtal via den mobila veterinärtjänsten.
duty_i18n.da: Søn–tor 9.00–17.00, lør 9.00–14.00; lukket på helligdage. Behandler hunde, katte, fugle, kaniner og skildpadder; akutte opkald via den mobile dyrlægetjeneste.
duty_i18n.fi: su–to 9–17, la 9–14; suljettu pyhäpäivinä. Hoitaa koiria, kissoja, lintuja, kaneja ja kilpikonnia; päivystyskäynnit liikkuvan eläinlääkäripalvelun kautta.
duty_i18n.nb: Søn–tor kl. 9.00–17.00, lør kl. 9.00–14.00; stengt på helligdager. Behandler hunder, katter, fugler, kaniner og skilpadder; akuttanrop via ambulerende tjeneste.
duty_i18n.sl: Ned–čet 9–17, sob 9–14; ob javnih praznikih zaprto. Zdravijo pse, mačke, ptice, zajce in želve; nujni klici prek mobilne službe.
duty_i18n.hr: ned–čet 9:00–17:00, sub 9:00–14:00; blagdanima zatvoreno. Liječi pse, mačke, ptice, zečeve i kornjače; hitni pozivi putem mobilne veterinarske službe.

notes: Thin result. Not reachable/unusable: Dhaka Tribune and Daily Sun (WebFetch client error); Central Veterinary Hospital Dhaka and DLS pages (no clinic page found/opened); Sylhet Agricultural University (only dean's office contact, no hospital page); Bangladesh Veterinary Council (not located). Not included for lack of phone/website on opened pages: Precise PetLab Diagnostics & Hospital (Gulshan, claims 24/7 emergency per UNB), Dr. Sagir's Pet Clinic Gulshan, Pawsitive Veterinary Clinic.
